label: Property price per m²

fields.name: prix_m2
fields.label: Median price per m² (houses and flats, 2023–2025)

fields.name: ventes_nb
fields.label: Usable sales in the three-year pool

legend_note: What dwellings actually sold for, from the tax authority's transfer records. Median commune €1,426/m²; Paris €9,692, Lyon €4,800, Marseille €3,282. Three years pooled (2023–2025), because at one year the sample runs out across most of rural France — pooling lifts coverage from 47% of communes to 72%. Blank means fewer than five usable sales, or Moselle, Bas-Rhin and Haut-Rhin, which have no DVF at all: Alsace-Moselle keeps a livre foncier instead of the cadastre this is published from.

label: Price of a house

fields.name: prix_maison_median
fields.label: Median price of a house sold, 2023–2025

legend_note: The total price of a whole house rather than a rate per m² — the number that decides whether somewhere is affordable. Median commune €165,000. It moves with house size as much as with land value, so read it against the price-per-m² layer: a low total in an expensive per-m² commune means the houses there are small.
